text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Vodka invited me to go see
one of those delinquent-themed action movies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the screening—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...
That was amazing... An absolute masterpiece, that's what it was!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist and his best bud aimed for the top
of the school together, fighting their way up with their fists...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Going head-to-head with the top dog of a rival school,
and then becoming pals... that's so hot~!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Going all out against each other really does
forge the strongest bonds of friendship.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You really do feel like you're pals with someone
after a fierce match with them—wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course there are ones who aren't like that too!
Like the ones who are just plain annoying!
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she means Daiwa Scarlet...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, never mind that!
What I'm trying to say is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Don't you think...
we need a one-on-one showdown too?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right? A trainer and their trainee
ought to understand each other on a deeper level, shouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There are some things you can only understand fist to fist!
Let's clash with all our passion, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like a weird switch got flipped in them.
I get what they're trying to say, but we can't
actually let them throw hands, so..."
choice_data_list: If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?
We'll settle this with a race...right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like a weird switch got flipped in them.
I get what they're trying to say, but we can't
actually let them throw hands, so..."
choice_data_list: If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?
We'll settle this with a race...right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Running, you say...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahahahaha!
Don't make me laugh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Challenging me to a running match...? Well, that's just plain reckless.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No way, that's totally out of theâ

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: W-Wait a sec... That was my line just now...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aren't you saying the exact same thing as that guy who got beat to a pulp in the movie earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Remember that punk at the beginning
who totally let his guard down seeing the protagonist's build?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Going by that turn of events... don't tell me
Trainer is actually crazy fast too...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
............Haah!
F-Fine, I guess I got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're gonna say that much,
I'll let you off the hook for today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea, alright?!
It's not like I was freaked out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Look, we just watched a movie today, so haven't we had our fill of fighting already... or what!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, call off the match for now, call it off! Let's just hurry up and go home."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And then, it's running practice!
...Just to be on the safe side!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seemed we managed to avoid a showdown for now.
Feeling inwardly relieved, I accompanied Vodka with her training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh...?
What's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: ...Maybe tell each other what we like about one another?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Wha...?!
H-Huuuuh?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
'A-A likeable part'?! What the heck is that?!
Makes zero sense, and this ain't a fistfight either!
choice_data_list: I figured, forget I said anything...
I thought so, forget I said anything...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to change the subject, saying it was merely a spur-of-the-moment thought—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Well, though?
I wouldn't mind letting you punch me... as much as you want?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, look... if you really wanna?
I'll let you punch me until you feel better."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Taking a full beating is part of being a pal anyway...
I'm totally fine with it, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: O-Ou! C-Come at me then!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, when I went on and on listing off
all the things I've come to love about Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—W-Wait, wait, wait, wait!!
That's enough, that's enough already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around the 50th one,
they finally made me stop.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on, how many more are there!?
It was so embarrassing my soul almost left my body midway through...!
choice_data_list: And also how hardworking you are—and...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaahhh~!
I told you I'm fine already!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously. How much is that?
Are they stupid...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Me too!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Guh... Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, just taking hits lying down isn't my style!
Just you wait, I'll knock you flat with a single line!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The thing I... l-l... about you is...
is.................."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —...Isn't that just... you being a nice person?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
UGRAAAAH~~!
Blush, you idiottttt!!
